reasoning_summary: Run is numerically healthy: completed, linear solvers converged, mass imbalance 6.667e-10, max Courant 0.74419, Re matches, force references consistent, 14 stationary cycles.
Statistical and averaging uncertainties are negligible (drag coefficient 1.125e-05 and 1.313e-05; Strouhal number 1.621e-05 and 9.748e-08).
Mesh, time-step and domain uncertainties are all unquantified because no refinement, time-step-reduction or domain-expansion run exists, so the error budget cannot be closed for either quantity.

Risk factors are present: blockage ratio 0.125 with symmetry walls at half-height 4D, against a requirement to treat the stream as unbounded; a coarse mesh (13070 cells, last wake cell 0.36188 D); and a Strouhal frequency resolution of 0.013333 against a Strouhal number of 0.17963 (about 7 %).
No demonstrated change exceeding the 3 % tolerance exists in the evidence, so REJECT is not justified. Acceptance is also unsupported, so the result is INCONCLUSIVE.
